verses.1: And they told David, “Look, the Philistines are fighting in Kiiila. They are destroying the foreigners.”
verses.2: And David asked the LORD, “Let me go and take these Philistines captive.” The LORD said to David, “Go and take those Philistines captive, and you will save Keilah from them.”
verses.3: And the men of David said to him, “Look, we are here in Judah, fearing God. But even if we go to the palaces of the Philistines, we will still be safe.”
verses.4: And David continued to ask God questions. And God answered him, saying, “Arise, Kilyah! I will give the Philistines into your hands.”
verses.5: David and his men went to Kheresa. They fought against the Philistines. They destroyed their camps and defeated them. David saved the people of Kheresa from destruction.
verses.6: And in the year 586, Ebedyar, son of Ahimelech, went to David Kailah. He carried it in his hands.
verses.7: And David told Shaul that David had arrived. Shaul said, “God has chosen him in my hands. Now the gates of the city are closed, and no one can enter.”
verses.8: And Shaul heard all the people preparing to go into battle, in order to attack David and his men.
verses.9: David knew that Shaul had brought evil upon him. So he said to the priest Abiatar, “Bring the plague upon him.”
verses.10: And David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has heard your servant’s prayer. Shaul desires to go to Kish and attack the city with my help.”
verses.11: Let me be sealed with the seal in His hand. May Sheol descend, just as your servant heard that the LORD, the God of Israel, has commanded him to serve you. And the LORD said, “Let Him come down.”
verses.12: And David said, “Let the men of Kehilah seal me and my people with Shaul’s hand. And let the LORD seal them.”
verses.13: David and his men rose up in groups of six each. They left Keilah and continued their journey along the path they had taken before. Shaul reported that David had been captured from Keilah, and he stopped trying to continue his journey.
verses.14: David settled in the desert, on its sides. He also settled in the mountains of Ziph. Shaul sought him all those days, but God did not give him anything.
verses.15: David saw that Saul had gone to ask for his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph during that time.
verses.16: And Johanan the son of Shaul stood up and went to David in Hebron. He strengthened his hand in God’s service.
verses.17: And he said to him, “Do not fear. For I will not find any hand of Saul your father among you. You shall reign over Israel, and I will be your helper. And Saul your father knows this.”
verses.18: And they made a covenant before Jehovah. David sat in the chair of judgment, while Jonathan went back to his home.
verses.19: And Ziphim went to Shaul in the wilderness, saying, “David is hiding with us in the wilderness on the right side of Jesimon.”
verses.20: And now, for all your soul’s longing to descend, let it do so. And let us be captured by the king’s hands.
verses.21: And Shaul said to them, “You are faithful to Jehovah, for you have acted with loyalty toward Him.”
verses.22: Please go and prepare for it yet. And know and see where it will be. Who saw it there? For it was said to me, “It’s a desolate forest.”
verses.23: And see and know from all those hideouts where they are hidden. Then come to me. I will take you with me. If he is still alive on this earth, I will search for him among all the thousands of Jews.
verses.24: And they got up and went ahead of Shaul and David, along with their men, across the sea at dawn. They headed towards the right side of Yashimon.
verses.25: Shaul and his men went out to seek help. They reported their situation to David. Then Shaul went down to the valley of Moron. Shaul heard that David was being pursued from the valley of Moron.
verses.26: Shaul went from the side of that mountain, and David and his men also went from the side of that mountain. David was eager to go away from Shaul’s presence. Shaul and his men rushed towards David and his men, in order to capture them.
verses.27: And the angel came to Shemaiah and said, “Quickly go away! For the Philistines have taken over the land.”
verses.28: Shaul then went after David. He went to seek out Philistine forces. That’s why they called that place “The Broken Rock”.
